name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM and IS Sahel attacks on state forces continue; no capital or major city has fallen or been newly blockaded
state: Jihadist groups continue to attack state forces across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger; the most recent large attack found was on a Malian army base, reported on 14 Sep, in which at least 50 soldiers were killed (Africanews). Searches on 15 Nov found no new fall or blockade of a capital or major city and no new mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states, so Watch holds.
for_you: No direct risk to UK residents. The FCDO advises against all or all but essential travel to much of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger; anyone with links to the region can follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: sustained insurgency at current levels; no capital or major city fallen or blockaded

sources.title: Africanews — At least 50 soldiers killed in jihadist attack on Malian army base

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
